{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Merino long-sleeve base layer, fitted, hip length, soft white (#f4f1ec), fine-gauge merino
Refined turtleneck knit, regular fit, hip length, dusty blue (#7fa6c8), merino-cashmere blend
High-rise straight trousers, full length to the ankle, deep navy (#1f2a44), lined wool-blend twill
Knee-length wrap coat, single-breasted with a hood-free collar, charcoal grey (#4a4f58), dense wool with a down-insulated lining, windproof
Waterproof ankle boots, low block heel with a deep lugged rubber sole, 3 cm heel, dark brown (#3b2a24), sealed full-grain leather with a warm fleece lining
Thick wool socks, mid-calf, heather grey (#9a9da3), merino wool
Long scarf, wrapped at the neck, light silver grey (#c3c6cc), soft lambswool
Knit beanie, close fit, navy (#1f2a44), wool with a fleece band
Gloves, wrist length, charcoal (#4a4f58), leather with a warm lining
Tote bag, structured, medium size, dark brown (#3b2a24), water-resistant treated leather

This outfit keeps the neat office look of a refined knit with tailored trousers, while the layers and the long wool coat handle deep frost and a walk through snow. The boots have grippy soles and sealed leather, so slush and road salt won't ruin them or make her slip. Dusty blue near the face echoes her eyes and sits well with her silver hair and fair skin, and the navy and charcoal keep the whole look calm and polished. The one continuous column of dark tones, with the straight trousers and the knee-length coat, makes the silhouette look longer and tidy, and the accessories are easy to take off once she is in the office."}
